source_documents.title: Proximal Steric Shielding Unlocks High Solid-State Luminescence in Quinoxaline-Fused Pyrene Heteroacenes

reference_evidence_units.quote: A modular synthetic route gives four soluble azaacenes with low solution PLQYs (6%–14%) but strongly enhanced emission in neat films.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compounds 1-4
reference_evidence_units.conditions: CHCl3 solution vs drop-cast neat films
reference_evidence_units.statement: Low PLQY in solution, high in neat films.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the high PLQY arises from a favourable solid-state arrangement in which proximal substituent geometry suppresses close π–π contacts and reduces non-radiative decay
reference_evidence_units.subject: compounds 1-4
reference_evidence_units.statement: Main explanation: steric suppression of π–π contacts.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Crystal structures are toluene solvates and may differ from films.

reference_evidence_units.quote: These observations confirm that the enhanced neat-film emission of TPE-QPHAs cannot be explained by conventional AIE behavior alone.
reference_evidence_units.subject: compounds 1-4
reference_evidence_units.statement: Aggregates in THF/water are not brighter and have shorter lifetimes than in THF.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Says 'alone': does not exclude a partial motion-restriction contribution.

reference_evidence_units.quote: This spatial separation of frontier orbital contributions provides clear evidence for the intramolecular charge-transfer nature of the lowest excited state
reference_evidence_units.subject: compounds 1-4 (NTOs shown for 3)
reference_evidence_units.statement: S1 has TPE-to-QPP charge-transfer character; solvatochromic emission.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Characterises the emissive state; not used to explain the solid-state enhancement.

reference_evidence_units.quote: This distortion allows slipped π–π stacked dimers with an interplanar distance of 3.41 Å
reference_evidence_units.subject: 3 (tetraPE-TMS)
reference_evidence_units.statement: Slipped π-stacked dimers in the crystal.

reference_evidence_units.quote: an improvement attributed to the restriction of intramolecular motions in the neat thin film that suppresses non-radiative decay
reference_evidence_units.subject: 1 and 3
reference_evidence_units.statement: Film PLQY rise of 1 and 3 attributed to restricted intramolecular motion.

reference_mechanisms.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Film enhancement of 1 and 3 attributed to restricted intramolecular motion.

reference_mechanisms.label: ICT_TICT_CT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Emissive state has TPE-to-core CT character (solvatochromism, NTOs); not the explanation of the solid-state enhancement.

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Solid-state emission governed by whether substituents prevent close π–π contacts between hexacene cores.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: Film enhancement of 1 and 3 attributed to restricted intramolecular motion.

mechanism_decisions.label: ICT_TICT_CT

mechanism_decisions.label: ESIPT_PT
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No intramolecular proton donor-acceptor pair (no OH/NH next to an acceptor).
